landing.heroTitle: Community flood reporting and coordinated rescue for East Godavari.
landing.heroSubtitle: Report waterlogging or embankments at risk, locate verified relief shelters, and coordinate rescue operations across Rajamahendravaram, Kakinada, Amalapuram, and the Godavari delta.
landing.helplineStripTitle: Immediate life-threatening emergency? Call official helplines first:
landing.mapPreviewSubtitle: Public map displays admin-verified community reports and relief shelters. Markers show reported points, not official flood-zone boundaries.
landing.recentAlertsEmpty: No active flood alerts at this moment.
landing.step1Desc: Submit GPS-tagged flood observations or urgent rescue requests with household needs and optional photos.
landing.step2Desc: Every report is reviewed by human coordinators before appearing publicly. Duplicate checks and AI summaries assist, never auto-verify.
landing.step3Desc: Assigned teams receive responder-only contact details, update live progress, and notify affected families at each milestone.
landing.rolesTitle: Built for Every Role in the Response Chain
landing.roleCitizenDesc: Report flood conditions, check nearby verified incidents, find open shelters, and track rescue requests.
landing.roleVolunteerDesc: Accept field support tasks, log ground observations, and keep relief shelter capacity accurate.
landing.roleRescueDesc: Manage assigned emergencies, view responder-only household contacts, and log live rescue status.
landing.roleAdminDesc: Verify incidents, dispatch rescue teams, publish official advisories, manage shelters, and track analytics.
landing.footerTagline: FloodConnect — Community flood monitoring & emergency response coordination for East Godavari, Andhra Pradesh.
landing.footerDisclaimer: FloodConnect complements—and never replaces—official emergency services. Always dial 112, 108, or 101 during life-threatening emergencies.
landing.footerCoverageText: Rajamahendravaram, Kakinada, Amalapuram, Dowleswaram Barrage, Mandapeta, and Godavari delta mandals.
landing.cap1Desc: Citizens pin exact floodwater points, road blockages, or embankment issues with GPS and photos. Reports remain private until reviewed by District Admins.
landing.cap1ImageAlt: FloodConnect citizen incident reporting and verification flow in East Godavari
landing.cap2Desc: Households log people counts, medical needs, and exact pins with a transparent 6-stage rescue tracker from Pending to Resolved.
landing.cap3Desc: Live severity-coded OpenStreetMap pins separate verified incidents from active East Godavari relief shelters and clearly distinguish point reports from flood polygons.
landing.cap4Desc: Rainfall, forecast, and Godavari river bulletins are never fabricated. When live official telemetry is absent, the platform states so transparently until a District Admin publishes a sourced entry.
landing.cap5Desc: Gemini-powered triage assists with categorization, duplicate proximity checks, priority suggestions, and Telugu/English translation — always marked advisory with mandatory human review.
landing.cap5ImageAlt: FloodConnect emergency coordination control room operations
landing.contactDesc: Reach the East Godavari coordination desk for shelter onboarding, volunteer partnerships, or rescue team account provisioning.
landing.heroMediaAlt: East Godavari riverfront and flood coordination overview

landing.workflowStep1Detail: Citizens report hazards or rescue needs with GPS pins and optional photos.

basin3d.simulationNotice: Interactive hydrological visualization with live FloodConnect incident pylons. Water stage slider is a simulation control, not a live CWC sensor feed.

assistant.pageSubtitle: Multi-turn flood guidance powered by Gemini and real-time hands-free voice assistance.
assistant.safetyBanner: AI guidance is advisory only and never replaces official District Control Room directives. For immediate life-threatening emergencies call 112 (Emergency), 108 (Ambulance), or 101 (Fire).
assistant.emptyBody: Ask about flood evacuation safety, relief preparation, reporting guidance, or emergency triage in English, Hindi, or Telugu.
assistant.promptSafety: What immediate steps should a family take if floodwater enters the ground floor?
assistant.promptKit: Give me a concise East Godavari monsoon emergency evacuation checklist.
assistant.promptTriage: How should I prioritize reporting a submerged bridge vs. a trapped household?
assistant.inputPlaceholder: Ask a flood safety, shelter, or coordination question...
